metric.name: Legacy modernization and enabling safer change
metric.text: Modernize legacy systems safely (e.g., Strangler Fig) by breaking dependencies to enable isolated work, rebalancing/refactoring while preserving invariants, and accounting for backporting/maintenance challenges.
